cap: Until week 7 every embryo has an indifferent gonad and both duct pairs. SRY on the Y chromosome makes a testis: Sertoli cells secrete AMH to remove the Müllerian ducts, Leydig cells secrete testosterone to keep the Wolffian (mesonephric) ducts, and 5α-reductase makes DHT for the external genitalia. Without SRY the default path keeps the Müllerian ducts.
